subject: URGENT: Triaged co-sell demo — compressed window and recording owner?
messages:
From: Anjali Rao <anjali@stellardevs.io>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-21 09:12 PDT
Subject: Re: Redwood / Siemco co-sell demo — exec availability

Hi Kimberly / team,

Quick update from our side: our VP of Product can only join for the first 45 minutes of the scheduled hour on Wednesday (11:00–12:00 PDT). They can’t move later. The rest of our team can stay the full hour.

We really want the exec-facing pitch + a short Q&A. Is there any way to compress the run-of-show to 45 minutes and still capture the technical deep-dive for the SI folks after the exec leaves? If you can record the session that would also help — we’ll share it internally.

Attendees (tentative): Mark Hurst (VP), Priya Singh (Sales), ops@siemco.com

Thanks — can you confirm by noon PST?

— Anjali
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Anjali Rao <anjali@stellardevs.io>
Date: 2027-06-21 09:45 PDT
Subject: URGENT: Triaged co-sell demo — compressed window and recording owner?

Thanks Anjali — noted. Internal plan below.

Option A (preferred): 45-minute combined session (11:00–11:45 PDT) with a recorded post-demo 20–30 minute technical breakout for SI attendees only (recorded and delivered within 24 hours).
Option B: Keep the hour, but put the exec pitch in first 30 minutes and move technical Q&A to a follow-up deep-dive the same day (shorter to respect bandwidth).

I attached an updated run_of_show_v3.pdf with a compressed timeline (slide deck trimmed, demo snippet shortened). Can someone (internal) own recording and upload? I can own the exec intro and customer-facing walkthrough.

Action items (internal):
- Vanessa: confirm scheduling and update calendar invite + attendee list.
- Jonas: confirm technical segment can be trimmed to a 15-min live demo + 10-min SI Q&A; volunteer for the 20-min post-demo breakout if needed.
- Priyom: volunteer to record the main session and produce a trimmed recording for Anjali’s execs (export + share).

Related: HubSpot deal RDW-2027-423 updated with compressed run-of-show link.

Attachments: run_of_show_v3.pdf, architecture-diagram.png

Thanks — I’ll hold off sending updated invite until Vanessa confirms timing.

— Kimberly Park
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: Anjali Rao <anjali@stellardevs.io>
Date: 2027-06-21 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: URGENT: Triaged co-sell demo — compressed window and recording owner?

Kim — can do. I reviewed the run_of_show_v3.pdf and we can compress the technical walkthrough:
- 10 min exec-facing product highlights (Kim)
- 15 min focused live demo (I’ll show the multi-region failover and straight-through routing)
- 10 min customer Q&A (exec + product)

If Anjali’s exec leaves at 11:45, we can spin a 20-min breakout immediately after for the SI team (11:50–12:10). I’ll host that and handle deeper architecture calls.

Small ask: can we get a 10-min tech pre-call at 10:30 PDT to confirm network access and SSO flows? Saves time during the compressed slot.

— Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Anjali Rao <anjali@stellardevs.io>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-21 12:18 PDT
Subject: Re: URGENT: Triaged co-sell demo — compressed window and recording owner?

Anjali — confirmed on our side: 45 minutes (11:00–11:45 PDT) works. I updated the calendar invite to end at 11:45 and added a 20-minute optional breakout at 11:50 for SI technical follow-up. Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh

Priyom — can you own the recording? Please capture the main session and the breakout. We’ll trim the recording and upload to the Drive link Kimberly mentioned.

Jonas — 10:30 PDT tech pre-call is good. I added a 10-minute hold.

Anjali — please confirm final attendee list when you can and whether recording distribution is ok with Siemco’s security/comms team.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partner Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Anjali Rao <anjali@stellardevs.io>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-21 15:38 PDT
Subject: Re: URGENT: Triaged co-sell demo — compressed window and recording owner?

Perfect — thank you all. Final attendee list: Mark Hurst (VP Product), Priya Singh (Sales), Arun Patel (Lead Infra), plus a couple of engineers (ops@siemco.com). Recording + edited highlights are fine to share internally.

We’ll join the 10:30 tech pre-call. Do you need anything else from our side (network logs, SSO test account)?

— Anjali
Product Partnerships | Stellardevs (Siemco customer)
